statement: A loan's due date is the checkout date plus the item type's loan period: 21 days for a book, 7 for a tool, 14 for a game and 7 for a dvd.

faults.description: Books get a 28-day loan period instead of 21.
Every loan uses the book loan period regardless of item type.

statement: Members get 3 grace days and guests get none; billable days are days late minus grace days, never negative.

faults.description: Members get only 2 grace days (guests unaffected).
Guests get 1 grace day (members unaffected).
Billable days ignore grace days entirely.

statement: The daily late rate is 10 cents for book and dvd and 25 cents for tool and game for members, and doubled for guests.

faults.description: Guests are no longer charged double (members unaffected).
The dvd daily rate becomes 15 cents for everyone.
Members are charged the doubled rate too (guests unaffected).

statement: A late fee never exceeds 1500 cents for members or 1000 cents for guests, and an unknown patron class is rejected with INVALID_PATRON_CLASS.

faults.description: The guest cap is raised to 1500 cents (members unaffected).
The cap is not applied for anyone.
The patron class check is skipped, so an unknown class fails with a different error.

statement: A hold queue is ordered by priority class (staff, then member, then guest) and, within a class, by the order holds were placed.

faults.description: The queue is sorted by arrival only, ignoring priority class.
Guests outrank members in the priority ranking.

statement: A patron may have only one hold per item (a second is rejected with DUPLICATE_HOLD) and an unknown priority class is rejected with INVALID_PRIORITY.

faults.description: The duplicate check is inverted, rejecting holds from patrons who are not already queued.
The priority validation is skipped, so an unknown class fails with a different error.

statement: Renewing before or on expiry extends from the current expiry by one year, a lapsed renewal extends from the renewal date by one year, and 29 February maps to 28 February in a non-leap year.

faults.description: The new expiry is always based on the current expiry, even for lapsed memberships.
faults.find: expiry if renewal <= expiry else renewal

faults.description: A 29 February expiry moves to 1 February instead of 28 February in a non-leap year.

statement: Renewing from 30 days before expiry up to the expiry date, inclusive, earns a 10% discount rounded down to a whole cent; all other renewals pay the full fee.

faults.description: The 30-days-before boundary is made exclusive, so a renewal exactly 30 days early pays full price.
The early-renewal window shrinks to 14 days.
The discount calculation is left incomplete, so the module cannot be imported.
